rules.name: Covenant
rules.text: The leader of your gathering must be a Lich and may initially only take spells from the necromancy list. Spells of other types can be gained as normal during a campaign.

leaderTrait.name: Erudite
leaderTrait.text: Each time this leader rolls mana dice for spellcasting, on any rolls of 9–10 do not discard that mana dice from the gathering’s mana pool.

trait.name: Apprentice
trait.text: This model knows 1 spell that is also known by the gathering’s leader. When spellcasting they use the gathering’s mana pool as normal. This model suffers arcane backlash on a channelling roll of 1–2. This trait cannot be taken by a leader and only one model in the gathering may have it.
